title: A Highland Prospecting Survey goes into the hills under Khālid ibn Yaḥyā Raḥḥū, fifty-nine, once of the dīwān, son of the old captain of the Volunteers of the Faith: prospectors and assayers to walk the streambeds, hammer the outcrops and test the rocks for metal. At Almonaster in the Sierra the copper workings throw up acrid yellow smoke that drives the workers off the slope and wilts the grass downwind, and the farmers bring a formal complaint

data.leader: Khālid ibn Yaḥyā Raḥḥū, Zenati, Sunni, 59 (80/85/78), architect, hardy warrior

event.name: Toxic Smoke from the Workings
event.text: the copper prospect yields ore of unexpected character; the first roasting heap, set to drive off the sulphides before smelting, gives off acrid yellow smoke; the metallurgist offers to build proper roasting kilns at unbudgeted cost
event.choiceOnScreen: Abandon the prospect. Locals are not wrong about the air (the choice made is not yet recorded)

otherExpeditions: Circumnavigation (west, round the southern cape and home by the Cape of Good Hope)

state.age: the Age of Renaissance has begun
